review_notes:
I read the whole file and checked it for new definitions that compete with Mathlib concepts. I did not open the Mathlib or Tau Ceti sources, so this rests on the file text alone.

The only new `def`s are the private maps `laurentHom₁`, `laurentHom₂` and `laurentHom₁₂`. Each is a named specialisation of the library's own `rationalQuotientHom`, so none competes with an existing concept.

The difference map is built from Mathlib's `AddMonoidHom.fst`, `AddMonoidHom.snd` and `RingHom.prod`, and the exactness statement uses `Function.Exact`. The auxiliary lemmas are theorem-level helpers, which this rubric excludes. I therefore found no avoidable parallel version of an existing concept.
